log: Fresh container: toolchain, Android SDK and all 138 reference screenshots restored.
Headless review harness, blind A/B tool and critic protocol in place.
Hub: per-game pause button, pause sheet, Android back button; phone renders at a 540-wide logical canvas.
Wave 1 started: 6 native ports, engine typography, blind baseline reviews of the 6 existing games.
Blind round 0: all six existing native games lost to their references. Six re-pass builders started on the critics' ranked gap lists.
Block Storm re-pass merged; round 1 blind review started.
Block Storm round 1: reference wins only slightly (was overwhelming); ours now wins on effects and juice. Round 2 started.
Helix Drop re-pass merged; round 1 blind review started.
Roller Splat re-pass merged; round 1 blind review started. Block Storm builder resumed on round 2.
Helix Drop round 1: OURS WINS the blind comparison (slight). Confirmation round queued after the font upgrade.
Roller Splat round 1: reference wins clearly (was overwhelming). Builder resumed on round 2.
Typography upgrade merged into every game. Mob Clash native port merged; round 1 blind review started. Hub builder started.
Mob Clash round 1: reference wins overwhelmingly (crowd mass, lighting, camera). Builder resumed on round 2.
Block Storm round 2: OURS WINS the blind comparison by a clear margin.
Roller Splat round 2: OURS WINS the blind comparison (slight).

Pin Rescue port merged; round 1 lost clearly (flat 2D tubes and hairline pins). Road Hopper re-pass, Horde Arena and Rooftop Run ports merged and sent blind; Helix and Block Storm confirmation rounds started.

engine.name: Review harness
engine.note: Headless renderer, scripted touches, demo mode, blind A/B pairs.

engine.name: Typography
engine.note: Filled vector text: Fredoka Bold display + Nunito ExtraBold UI (OFL), outlines, gradients, shadows. Live in every game.

engine.name: Hub & shell
engine.note: Pause sheet done. Builder rebuilding the home screen as a bright casual-game lobby with account level, gems, missions and streak.

engine.name: Android APK
engine.note: Builds and installs; logical-resolution fix and back button pending a device build.

games.name: Road Hopper
games.gap: Re-pass landed: four worlds, voxel props, five vehicle types, deaths, eagle, results and roster. Round 1 blind review running.

games.name: Block Storm
games.gap: Won round 2. Polish landed; confirmation round against different reference shots running.

games.name: Helix Drop
games.gap: Won round 1. Meta added (trophy card, chest room, level map); confirmation round against different reference shots running.

games.name: Roller Splat
games.gap: Won on HUD, palette, readability and polish. Reference still has deeper wall extrusion and stronger camera tilt; depth pass under way.

games.name: Void Muncher
games.gap: No swallow juice, flat lighting, hole reads as a sticker, weak HUD, sparse props.

games.name: Chrome Rush
games.gap: Static crash, single daytime biome, empty lower screen, primitive cars.

games.name: Mob Clash: Gate Siege
games.gap: Crowd is a thin trickle, not a mass; flat unlit scene; weak boss; camera too high; thin gates; tiny impact effects.

games.name: Pin Rescue
games.gap: Containers and pins are hairline 2D outlines; balls tiny; playfield small; bombs invisible until they blow. Ours wins on the win celebration.

games.name: Rooftop Run
games.gap: Native port landed: chase camera, trains and roofs, power-ups, inspector chase, revive and results. Round 1 blind review running.

games.name: Horde Arena
games.gap: Native port landed: joystick, 7 weapons with evolutions, XP draft, elites, bosses, lucky chest, results. Round 1 blind review running.

games.name: Avian Artillery
games.gap: Native port in progress (was web-only); landscape.
